prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload a Clear Photo of Your Pet", "For best results, use well-lit photos with your pet facing forward.", "Good lighting, sharp focus, single pet in frame"]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Try moving and controlling your pet in the sandbox below before placing it on your desktop.", "Try Desktop Controls"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Checking graphics renderer, desktop tray access, and asset files...", "Display Engine Initialized", "Tray Icon Active"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop World", "Choose whether you want a pre-made pet companion or a custom creation from your own photos."]
4: ["Signing into an existing account safely recovers all previously adopted pets and inventory.", "Safe Cloud Sync Active"]
5: ["Generation takes 1 to 3 minutes depending on model complexity.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "If your pet hides, click the tray icon in your taskbar or press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon it instantly.", "Got It, Let's Play"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered and ready to move onto your desktop!", "Verified Companion"]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Each path includes exclusive starter accessories for your companion.", "Instant Pre-Made or Custom Creator"]
9: ["We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready to join your desktop.", "Notify Me When Ready"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or exclusive items
